segments.mil7.5.4:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘vicchikassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.5.4:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, vicchiko naṅgulāvudho naṅgulaṃ ussāpetvā carati,
segments.mil7.5.4:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena ñāṇāvudhena bhavitabbaṃ, ñāṇaṃ ussāpetvā viharitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.4:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, vicchikassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
